description: EDGE_PROCESS steps 3 and 4 for one registered hypothesis: every grid point scored on the training part's folds (each one a trial, counted in N), the best scored once on the holdout, the clauses U1-U13 judged, and one experiment written through the scoped research role. Reads the lake read-only; runs once and is never restarted. Artifacts (trials, holdout returns, the verdict) go to the lake under jobs/<instance>.

hypothesis_id.title: Hypothesis
hypothesis_id.description: The registered hypothesis's number (Edges). Its dataset must read '<lake folder> <interval> <from>..<to>'.

family.title: Strategy family

x-labels.trend-band: Trend band: an SMA lookback and a band (the live rule's family)
x-labels.orb: Opening-range breakout: CME futures, one trade per session
x-labels.carry: Carry: long spot, short the perpetual, entered when funding runs high
x-labels.trend-vol: Trend, volatility-managed: the live rule's signal, sized down when volatility runs high

family.x-note: The hypothesis's parameters must be the family's: trend-band tunes lookback (bars) and band (a fraction); orb tunes orb_minutes, target_r and exit (target or trail), on a raw/cme/... dataset with per-contract costs and the session-hold baseline; carry tunes lookback (bars), enter_apr and exit_apr (a year's funding, as a fraction) and declares leverage (one choice), on a 'raw/kucoin/futures/<instance>+raw/kucoin/spot/<instance>' dataset (perpetual first, one venue) with the always-carry baseline and fees per leg; trend-vol tunes trend-band's lookback and band plus vol_lookback (bars), target_vol (a year's volatility) and rebalance (a fraction of full size), against buy-and-hold or trend-200d-5pct. Its dataset is trend-band's, so pick it here: nothing infers it.
